title: ananas comosus var. ananassoides
intro: Ananas comosus var. ananassoides, commonly known as the red pineapple, is a variety of the pineapple plant that is characterized by its reddish-purple leaves and edible red fruits. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Ananas comosus var. ananassoides include wound healing, anti-microbial activity, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including bromelain and various phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, are responsible for its therapeutic effects and may provide protection against oxidative stress and inflammation.
